lessons: Redo the clutch/serve.py work in full. Review found the overlap sound: select drops driver_pending(), run_driver runs without mutations(), Serve.run's start gate drops upgrade_idle(), upgrade_idle checks driver_task is None, and a class attribute driver_task = None is added.

In Serve.run's main loop, when a finished pass is collected, clear the task before reading its result (task, self.driver_task = self.driver_task, None; task.result()). Then wait_driver() reports only a failure that first shows up at the shutdown wait, and serve_failed is logged once.

In tests/integration/test_serve_driver_overlap.py::test_pass_failure_stops_serve, assert exactly one serve_failed event in both parametrized cases (failure in the loop and failure at the shutdown wait). Checking that at least one exists missed the duplicate log.

Keep the new tests in tests/unit/test_serve_driver_overlap.py and tests/integration/test_serve_driver_overlap.py. Import tests/integration/serve_rig.py and never edit it. Update test_driver_hooks.py, test_serve_driver.py and docs/how-clutch-works.md sections 7.5 and serve as the ticket says.
